releases.title: Never miss an update

highlights.title: Update reminders
highlights.text: VisionX tells you when a new version is out, and waits two days if you tap Later.

highlights.title: One-tap update
highlights.text: Update right from the app. No need to run the installer again.

highlights.title: See what's new first
highlights.text: Every update shows its three best features before you install it.

changes: Update check when VisionX opens, with a what's-new sheet (Update now / Later)
Later, or tapping outside the sheet, hides the offer for two days
An offer that arrives during a capture session waits until the session ends
Version shown at the bottom of the app
releases.json, CHANGELOG.md, tools/changelog.js and docs/RELEASING.md

releases.title: Triggers for repeated moments

highlights.title: Each new occurrence
highlights.text: Run a shortcut every time something happens again, like each new thumbs-up.

highlights.title: See why it ran
highlights.text: Every trigger check shows whether its shortcut ran, and why or why not.

highlights.title: Clearer trigger options
highlights.text: Each run setting explains itself in the trigger editor.

changes: New run setting "Each new occurrence": the check is told what had happened when the shortcut last ran
"What VisionX did" in the debug log for every trigger check
Hints for each run setting in the trigger editor
fixes: A trigger whose condition stayed true in a growing summary never ran again, with no explanation

releases.title: Triggers in step with photos

highlights.title: Check after each photo
highlights.text: Triggers can run right after every photo, against the newest summary.

highlights.title: Next photo waits
highlights.text: No new photo is taken until the triggered shortcuts have finished.

highlights.title: Steady screen
highlights.text: Pinch and double-tap no longer zoom the app by accident.

changes: Trigger option "When to check": every few seconds, or after each photo is analyzed
In fresh mode, the next photo waits for all triggered shortcuts
Status shows "Running triggers for photo #n" while waiting
fixes: The interface could be pinch-zoomed or double-tap zoomed

releases.title: See what the AI sees

highlights.title: Debug log
highlights.text: The last 10 photos with exactly what was sent and what came back.

highlights.title: Readable JSON
highlights.text: Tracked details and model replies are syntax-highlighted.

highlights.title: Copy as JSON
highlights.text: Copy the whole log, without photos, to share or inspect.

changes: Debug panel with request, raw reply, parsed reply, usage and trigger checks per photo
Syntax highlighting for JSON, including JSON inside text replies

releases.title: Apple Intelligence, hands-free

highlights.title: No paste prompts
highlights.text: Turn off Show each photo here to run without iOS asking to paste.

highlights.title: Summary always shows
highlights.text: Apple's replies are read in more shapes, so the summary never stays empty.

highlights.title: Details stay intact
highlights.text: Multi-line tracked details are kept and passed on to the next photo.

changes: "Show each photo here" switch for Apple Intelligence
Apple Intelligence is asked for a simple labelled reply (FRAME, SUMMARY, STATE)
fixes: iOS asked to allow pasting after every photo
The running summary stayed empty with Apple Intelligence
Tracked details were cut to a single "{" from the second photo on

releases.title: Better instructions in one tap

highlights.title: Full-screen editor
highlights.text: Expand your instructions into a roomy editor with a word count.

highlights.title: Refine with AI
highlights.text: Make instructions clearer, more specific or shorter with one tap.

highlights.title: You decide
highlights.text: Compare the suggestion with your text, then use it or undo it.

changes: Expand and Refine with AI buttons next to the instructions

releases.title: Zoom while capturing

highlights.title: Zoom slider
highlights.text: Zoom from 1× to 5×, even in the middle of a session.

highlights.title: Sharp camera zoom
highlights.text: Uses the iPhone's own zoom when available, cropping only beyond it.

highlights.title: Aim with ease
highlights.text: The live preview grows while you zoom so you can frame the shot.

changes: Higher camera resolution so digital zoom keeps more detail

releases.title: Say it your way

highlights.title: Custom trigger messages
highlights.text: Send your own text to a shortcut instead of the summary.

highlights.title: Smart placeholders
highlights.text: Fill in the reason, time, trigger name or summary automatically.

highlights.title: Clear at a glance
highlights.text: The trigger list shows what each trigger will send.

changes: Per-trigger choice of Shortcut Input: the capture summary or a custom message

releases.title: Your iPhone as a smart camera

highlights.title: AI photo watch
highlights.text: Takes a photo every few seconds and has AI analyze it your way.

highlights.title: Shortcut triggers
highlights.text: Run any Apple Shortcut when a condition you describe is met.

highlights.title: OpenAI or Apple
highlights.text: Use any OpenAI model, or Apple Intelligence through Shortcuts.

changes: Timed capture with a running or per-photo summary beside the latest photo
Instruction presets, API key management and a model list from your account
Triggers with live status, on/off switches and session stats
install.js installer and README with screenshots
